label: Python Engineering
cardNote: 🐍 Tools and services that stay easy to understand
headline: Python tools, services, and data workflows
that stay easy to read, test, and change.
summary: On Python projects, I usually start with inputs and the data model, then move through implementation, testing, packaging, and deployment. I try to keep the code straightforward and make failures easy to trace when they happen.

freelance: Built web services, CLI tools, automation scripts, and data-transformation modules with Python.
Designed APIs and data models, validated inputs, and prepared projects for testing, deployment, and maintenance.
security: Applied security experience to input handling, authentication, dependency review, logging, and application behavior during failures.
When debugging a service or script, I first make a test case that repeats the problem and run it again after the fix.
company: Worked on distributed applications, NoSQL databases, and APIs shared by mobile and web clients.
Took part in design, implementation, integration debugging, and final delivery.
